DependencyCheck: Response data: dependency check, used by GET /api/v1/health/dependencies (Heartbeat Redis, ChromaDB and the database (Supabase))
DependencyCheck.detail: Extra detail about the dependency check after 'Heartbeat Redis, ChromaDB and the database (Supabase)', e.g. the reason or what was checked
MessageResponse: Generic message response for mutation operations.
MessageResponse.message: Short message shown to the user after 'Delete a vehicle'; one or two sentences explaining the result and the next step
VehicleOwnerOnboardingVerificationResult: Response data: vehicle owner onboarding verification result, used by POST /api/v1/onboarding/vehicle-verification (Submit vehicle info to the manufacturer for ownership verification)
Short message shown to the user after 'Submit vehicle info to the manufacturer for ownership verification'; one or two sentences explaining the result and the next step
WarrantyOut: Response data: warranty, used by GET /api/v1/onboarding (Get the current onboarding state and saved data), POST /api/v1/onboarding/vehicle-verification (Submit vehicle info to the manufacturer for ownership verification)
WarrantyOut.termsDescription: Plain-language warranty terms: what is covered, conditions, exclusions and how to claim
